text: The referee is right there near the incident.
fr: L'arbitre est tout près de l'incident.

text: A Union player is down around midfield.
fr: Un joueur de Union reste au sol vers le milieu.

text: Two players are down around the halfway line.
fr: Deux joueurs sont au sol près du milieu de terrain.

text: Jae-sung is there in midfield for Mainz.
fr: Jae-sung est là au milieu pour Mainz.

text: Players cluster around the edge of the penalty area.

text: Amiri there, wearing the 05ers shirt.

text: Klaus waits on his own goal line.

text: Amiri stands over it on the right side.

text: The ball sits out by the far touchline.

text: A Union player close to it in the middle.

text: Mainz keep it calmly inside their own half.
fr: Mainz conserve calmement dans sa propre moitié.

text: Amiri has it wide near the touchline.

text: The referee holds position just around midfield.

text: The 05ers keep possession close to the halfway line.

text: Mainz are on the ball by the right touchline.

text: Veratschnig is stationed by the near touchline.

text: Zentner is on it inside his penalty area.

text: The ball rests over by the far sideline.

text: The 05ers control it around halfway.

text: Play settles again around the middle of the pitch.

text: Mainz work the ball just outside the box.
fr: Mainz fait circuler le ballon juste devant la surface.

text: Mainz carry possession out near the right touchline.
fr: Mainz garde le ballon près de la ligne de touche droite.

text: Becker keeps it tight along the touchline.
fr: Becker garde le ballon près de la ligne de touche.

text: Klaus has the ball inside his own penalty area.
fr: Klaus a le ballon dans sa propre surface.

text: Union hold steady possession wide by the touchline.

text: Union hold it wide near the touchline.
fr: Union garde le ballon près de la ligne de touche.

text: The referee stands close by Veratschnig.
fr: L'arbitre se tient tout près de Veratschnig.

text: Mr Exner goes to his pocket for yellow.
fr: M. Exner sort le carton jaune.

text: A Union Berlin player fills the close-up now.
fr: Un joueur de Union Berlin apparaît en gros plan.

text: The board shows Weiper on for Tietz.
fr: Le panneau annonce Weiper à la place de Tietz.

text: The ball drops loose inside the penalty area.

text: Sieb and Becker are stationed near the touchline.
fr: Sieb et Becker se tiennent près de la ligne de touche.

text: Becker waits wide, right by the touchline.
fr: Becker patiente au large, tout près de la ligne de touche.

text: Weiper waits in place near the goalmouth.
fr: Weiper attend près de la cage.

text: Sieb stands over it, wide on the right.
fr: Sieb se place au-dessus du ballon, côté droit.

text: Several Mainz shirts gather inside the penalty area.
fr: Plusieurs maillots de Mainz se regroupent dans la surface.

text: Sieb is picked out in the Mainz close-up.
fr: Sieb est cadré de près côté Mainz.

text: Becker lingers beside the 05ers bench.
fr: Becker reste près du banc des 05ers.

text: The ball rests beside the left touchline.

text: Ansah is the player picked out by the camera.
fr: Ansah est le joueur cadré par la caméra.

text: Juranovic gets the camera’s attention in close-up.
fr: Juranovic est cadré de près par la caméra.

text: Ansah is on the ball now.
fr: Ansah a le ballon maintenant.
